rows.grounds: compound: janma-ādi-akhila-saṃskāra-śuddhaḥ (nom. sg. m., purified of all purificatory rites from birth onward) + agniḥ (nom. sg. m., fire) + tāvatā (instr. sg. n./m., to that extent); sandhi split marked by @
compound: pañca-aṅgam (nom./acc. sg. n., five-limbed) + eva (indeed, emphatic particle)
compound: pṛthvī-ādi-rūpam (nom./acc. sg. n., having the form of earth and so forth)
compound: kaṭhinatā-ādikāḥ (nom. pl. f., hardness and the like)
